files.planning.md:
<!-- prompt: planning -->
# Planning
Use core.todo_list to coordinate work.

<!-- prompt: response -->
Keep responses concise.
files.test_flow.py:
import unittest
from prompt_loader import load_sections


class PromptContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_planning_contract(self):
        sections = load_sections()
        self.assertEqual(set(sections), {'planning', 'response'})
        planning = sections['planning'].lower()
        self.assertIn('core.todo_list', planning)
        self.assertIn('basic tool', planning)
        self.assertIn('not a skill', planning)
        self.assertEqual(sections['response'], 'Keep responses concise.')
